prompt: vilket är bästa sättet att sänka elkostnaden i en villa med solpaneler, batteri och värmepump

recommendations.title: Refresh: Step-by-step guide — "Så sänker du elkostnaden i din villa"
recommendations.details: Create a concise, actionable guide aimed at Stockholm villaägare that lists the recommended priority sequence (1. energy efficiency and insulation, 2. right-sized solar panels, 3. efficient värmepump or heat-pump optimisation, 4. battery and smart controls). For each step include decision triggers (e.g., yearly consumption thresholds, payback thresholds), estimated annual savings ranges, and links to existing pages for deeper reading. Add a short checklist homeowners can follow before requesting an offer.
suggestedSections: Introduktion: mål och förutsättningar för villor i Stockholm
När ska du välja isolering/effektivisering vs PV/batteri/ värmepump
Snabbkalkyl: grov uppskattning av kostnad och årlig besparing

recommendations.title: Create: Practical battery & control sizing and ROI comparison
recommendations.details: Produce a detailed comparative article that shows common villa consumption profiles, recommended battery sizes and PV pairings, and modelled ROI/savings under different tariff scenarios (with and without effektavgift). Include worked examples (e.g., 7 kWp + 10 kWh battery vs 7 kWp alone) using the site's price and spot‑price inputs, and show break‑even times and annual savings from self‑consumption and peak shaving.

recommendations.title: Refresh: Practical control strategies for heat pump, EV and battery
recommendations.details: Add a guidance page (or expand an existing FAQ) describing concrete control strategies: time‑shift heating and EV charging to PV production/battery state, simple rules for evening heat pump boosting from battery, and how AI/smart controllers can increase egenanvändning. Include example daily schedules and expected additional self‑consumption percentages from each measure.
